artifact.archive_verification: Downloaded and size/SHA-256 verified by parent; reports read from supplied extraction.

report_comparison.nonmaterial_event_changes: Available-disk measurements and per-run job directory; no source/count/classification difference.

pinned_inputs.individual_input_hash_scope: The passing compare_snapshot contract verifies original per-input sha256, stored_sha256 and source_path against this pinned preservation snapshot. Individual input hash values are not enumerated in these artifact reports and are not inferred here.

held_dispositions.scope: Completed semantic dispositions for formerly held IDs; source gaps remain explicit and already-registered sibling-language queues are separate.

limits: This fresh step verifies provider source fidelity, saved-review projections and held-state accounting only. The full-corpus build, production browser acceptance, baseline/candidate benchmark and deployment/live verification are separate gates and are not claimed passed.
Saved positive-review admission totals are a replay relative to the historical provider baseline, not new admissions made by the UI/search implementation or a net total-bank change.
No independent authenticity/translation assessment; source gaps and commentary exclusions remain explicit.
